svg.title: Agon Light 2 to Olimex P4-PC Rev C — complete headers and straight-across wiring
svg.desc: Unversioned P4-PC wiring review draft. Derived from the legacy wiring diagram and native p4-pc board profile. All 34 Agon and 20 PC contacts shown. No sniffer markers or series resistors.
svg.text: Agon Light 2 → Olimex ESP32-P4-PC Rev C
Wiring review draft · Unversioned · Native build selection: p4-pc
Board-side views: look down onto the connector pins. Pin 1 is outlined; wiring-side socket views are mirrored.
Rotate the official horizontal pinout 90° counterclockwise; no mirror.
Component side: LAN / HDMI end above; USB-A end below.
Odd pins on the left; even pins on the right.
The square pin-1 pad is the +3.3 V contact.
Breadboard wiring — same bank separation and wire colours as the original SVG
Below, each header row is separated and reversed (high pin numbers at top) to keep the data wires straight.
Eight data pull-ups: 15 kΩ each to Agon pin 34 (+3.3 V). READY_N and VALID_N: 10 kΩ pull-ups to that same rail.
CLOCK: 10 kΩ pull-down to common ground. Handshake values follow the original drawing; data values follow the later harness.
P4-PC EXT1-19 / GPIO47 and EXT1-20 / GPIO48 remain spare. GPIO20/32 sensing links must remain disconnected.
Connect the common ground only; do not join the independently powered Agon and P4-PC positive supply rails.
READY_N has one jog because Agon pin 15 is unused. No series resistors or sniffer circles. A square dot marks a rail junction.
Pin authority: vdp/build/boards/p4-pc.json · Physical reference: Olimex Rev C schematic and top silkscreen · 2026-10-04
